_guide: Each station is a skin, not an audio player. Upload images, then fill artwork/backgroundArt/overlayArt/badgeArt with HTTPS same-origin or trusted HUMKIN artwork URLs. Colors are hex values. layout: console, portrait, banner or compact. Undefined stations inherit the default. Never put audio URLs here; live routes come from the station registry.
